This article embeds the interactive pkgnet dependency report only on the
GitHub‑built pkgdown site. It does not ship the report in the package
and does not attempt to generate it locally.

```{r}
#| results: asis
report_path <- file.path("pkgdown", "assets", "pkgnet.html")
report_url <- "https://rkrug.github.io/openalexConvert/assets/pkgnet.html"
on_github_ci <- identical(Sys.getenv("GITHUB_ACTIONS"), "true") ||
  identical(Sys.getenv("CI"), "true")
if (knitr::is_html_output() && on_github_ci && file.exists(report_path)) {
  # Embed via iframe; path is relative to the rendered article location
  cat(
    '<iframe src="../assets/pkgnet.html" style="width:100%; height:900px; border:1px solid #ddd;"></iframe>\n',
    '<p style="margin-top:0.5rem">Open the report in a new tab: ',
    '<a href="',
    report_url,
    '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">',
    report_url,
    '</a></p>'
  )
} else {
  cat(
    'The interactive pkgnet report is available on the GitHub pkgdown site: ',
    '<a href="',
    report_url,
    '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">',
    report_url,
    '</a>.'
  )
}
```
